title: Landing gate: add a non-Windows Rust compile check so cfg(unix)-only breakage is caught before landing
outcome: A Rust change that breaks cfg(unix) or cfg(not(windows)) code cannot land from Central without a Linux or macOS compile failing first. The landing gate, or a mandatory pre-landing check, runs `cargo check --bin termal --tests` on a non-Windows target.
acceptance: The maintained landing procedure (test launcher or documented pre-landing step) includes a non-Windows `cargo check --bin termal --tests` on the exact input, e.g. through WSL Ubuntu on Central (memory central-wsl-linux-checks) or a remote runner.
Reintroducing a cfg(unix)-only compile error such as the w-91c2 E0282 makes that check fail.
